notes.title: Forlorn Outcast Beta Test Sign-Ups Open Now!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the upcoming Beta Test for Forlorn Outcast, an integral phase as we approach the game's official release. We invite you to step into Tilsa's mysterious realms, embrace the challenges, and collaborate with us to pinpoint and address unforeseen bugs. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping Zafira's journey.

Key Details:
Sign-Up Form: Enlist here
Platform: Exclusive to Windows PC
Duration: Dates to be announced soon

Discord Invite
Immerse yourself in our Discord community to discuss the Beta, share feedback, and bond with fellow adventurers.

We can't wait for you to get this early glimpse of Forlorn Outcast!
